response.challenge: same ordered Challenge fields as invitation v1 with public_beta_registration purpose; ticket includes terms

registration.project_id: p_ plus first 60 hex of ticket_id

callback_key.authentication: existing Ed25519 signed request v1; nonempty Idempotency-Key
callback_key.storage: no-store/private; never persist plaintext in command receipts/logs; no global master returned

status.response: public registration capacity and limits only; no tenant listing

destinations: existing signed invitation-v1 DTOs under /v1/destinations; explicit manage_destinations scope; only exact worker.account.workers.dev HTTPS receiver URLs
tasks: existing signed task DTOs: registered:<endpoint_id>, exact string body, operation_key, optional run_at_ms; schedule no later than trial expiry; no arbitrary URL
terms: 7-day identity/grant; accepted reservations survive expiry and callbacks can finish later. One unit means a leased attempt, not one task or money. First 10 lifetime projects, not invitations or a claim of Sybil resistance. No payments or autorecharge.
guard: not active until reviewed production master/rate bindings/namespace/Queue configuration and rollout are approved
